```
ERROR in src/app/custom-elements/code/pretty-printer.service.ts(27,14): error TS7016: Could not find a declaration file for module 'assets/js/prettify.js'. '/home/circleci/ng/aio/src/assets/js/prettify.js' implicitly has an 'any' type.
```
